questions.question: In Jesus' story of ten virgins waiting for the bridegroom, what did the five foolish ones not take along?
In Jesus' story of the ten virgins, why did the wise ones say no to sharing their oil?

answers.text: There may not be enough for both
The bridegroom told them not to
They planned to sell it later

questions.question: In Jesus' story of the ten virgins, what did the bridegroom say to the foolish ones outside the shut door?
At the end of the story of the ten virgins, why did Jesus tell people to keep watch?

answers.text: You do not know the day or the hour
The bridegroom always comes at midnight
The night is almost over now
